critic.fix_suggestion: Extend the upper-deck cylinder along the longitudinal axis to increase its length by 40% until it clears the cockpit area. Simultaneously, apply a 15-degree fillet/blend at the junction between the nose and the top section to smooth the curvature, and increase the vertical offset of this geometry by 20% relative to the main deck to create a more prominent second story.

discrepancies.observed: The upper-deck hump ends abruptly near the cockpit area.
discrepancies.reference: The hump extends significantly further back along the fuselage.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: increase length of the upper deck cylinder

discrepancies.observed: A sharp, distinct transition between the nose and the top section.
discrepancies.reference: A smooth, continuous curve blending into the main fuselage.

discrepancies.observed: The nose is overly rounded and blunt.
discrepancies.reference: A more tapered, aerodynamic point at the very tip.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: taper the front radius of the nose cylinder

discrepancies.observed: The hump appears relatively flat against the fuselage.
discrepancies.reference: A prominent, elevated second story that sits higher above the main deck.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: increase vertical offset of the upper-deck geometry
